message: オッパイ山ｉｎ神戸市三宮
All the exams were finally over.
We'd done everything we could; now all that was left was to leave it up to fate.
After school--
The Student Council members and their friends gathered in the Student Council room as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
Comparing answers, complaining about how hard studying had been, bragging about guessed topics hitting or missing the mark, and so on.
At any rate, everyone clearly wanted to release their tension and share in the joy together all at once.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, won't the new Student Council treasurer even serve a single cup of tea to her guests?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why is Bubuzuke here!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I had plans to go hang out with Ria today, you know?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Before that, Ria said she had a quick errand in the Student Council room, so I just tagged along with her.」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sorry, Akane-chan. I'm brewing the tea right now!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll use the highest-grade tea leaves the Student Council has. Please wait just a moment longer.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh, you really don't have to do all that. Please don't trouble yourself.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why, you little Bubuzuke! You're just trying to pick a fight with me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grr... I'll mix some dirty rag water into yours. Drip, drip~」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san, what a horrible thing to do!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry. Nanaka's just dripping in some honey she prepped beforehand.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, don't go spilling the beans!」

name: Misa
message: 「...Sakura-kun, you really know Nanaka-san well, don't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahaha, well, we're stuck with each other by rotten luck, you know?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What a silly girl you are, Nanaka-han. 'Rotten luck' means an ill-fated bond, doesn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Ahahaha, well, even if it's rotten, we're still childhood friends.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Why do you gotta phrase it like that? Sip, sip, gulp, gulp.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooooh, a stinky relationship!」

name: Sally
message: 「When Oyabin burps after eating a beef bowl with extra green onions, it's super stinky too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't lump Synn and me together with something like that!!」

name: Misa
message: 「As for the relationship between the two of them--」

name: Synn
message: 「Here you go, Misa, I brought the hot water. All that's left is Misasagi-senpai and Shio-chan's shares, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, ours can wait until after... Hey, hold on, Sakura-kun, what is the meaning of this?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Boil it properly until it's piping hot! Brewing black tea with lukewarm water is completely out of the question!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Treating Synn-sama like a tea boy and scolding him--that's a classic hysteric for you.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Gulp, gulp, phew~! Nana-chan, seconds on the black tea, hurry, hurry~. I want lemon tea this time~.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Read the room! Don't go guzzling it down just because you think it's free!」

name: Azel
message: 「It's free?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」

name: Ria
message: 「Please, come on in. There's a seat for you too, Azel-san?」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary.」

name: Sally
message: 「The student council is so lively~. Everyone gathers around. Lap, lap, splash, splash.」

name: Shio
message: 「Sally-dono, I must question those manners... Black tea is not meant to be scooped up and drunk one spoonful at a time, you know?」

name: Sally
message: 「Eh~? Because doing it this way is more fun and tastes better.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I get it! Even with Mr. Ramen, slurping up the soup using the handle end of the soup spoon tastes way better!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, I used to do that too.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's the right way to do it. Etiquette is just etiquette, after all. Put stiff manners second--when it comes to tea and grub, the one who enjoys them most wins.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay, I got praised~! Thank you~.」

name: Misa
message: 「Here, your tea.」

name: Shio
message: 「Much obliged, Sister.」
On top of the table.
A tape recorder sits prominently as if to say, 'Come on, press the play button!'

name: Sacchin
message: 「Boop~.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Sacchin. Even though you're my best friend, you really don't fear a thing...」

name: Helena
message: 「Good morning, members of the Student Council.」

name: Sally
message: 「Heya, Chairwoman!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, it is already time for 'good afternoon' rather than 'good morning,' you know.」

name: Helena
message: 「Good afternoon, members of the Student Council and its affiliates.」

name: Ria
message: 「Real-time? I wonder where big sis is hiding.」

name: Helena
message: 「First of all, good work on your exams.」

name: Helena
message: 「Furthermore, regarding your mission for today--」

name: Ria
message: 「No, I don't understand what 'furthermore' is doing there.」

name: Helena
message: 「I am issuing you a special order to take the day off.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, every day is Sunday for you, Sally-chan.」

name: Helena
message: 「Focus on work when it is time to work, and play with all your might when it is time to play. Things go much more smoothly that way.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, maintaining a good balance is the key to living a sparkling school life.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hey, hey, if the Chairwoman is saying that, does it mean our play money comes out of the Student Council budget?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Lucky! Let's play the claw machines at the arcade a ton! They just stocked limited-edition Blackuma plushies!」

name: Misa
message: 「--Where?! Which arcade?! Tell me!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hehe, the world is not that sweet. Making dreams come true in the adult world is hard work, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We are still children, though?」

name: Helena
message: 「I swiped the stamp card Melilot saved up from shopping district mail-orders out of her wallet-ahem!」

name: Helena
message: 「Through Melilot's generosity, she kindly gifted us her stamp card. Go live it up in the shopping district.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You mean the one pinned underneath the tape recorder?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, that one.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You've got sharp eyes, Sacchin.」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, you can't exactly go all out with just stamp cards, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoaaa! There are dozens of them! You can use these reward points at every shop in the shopping district--we really *can* live it up!」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, at a conservative estimate, it's worth fifty thousand yen.」

name: Synn
message: 「F-F-F-Fif--?!」

name: Synn
message: 「F-F-F-F-F-Fif, fifty th-th... mgh... eh... gah!! M-My heart...!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaaah?! Hang in there, Synn!」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, don't fall asleep! If you fall asleep, you'll die! Wake-up slap!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow-ow-ow-ow-ow!」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot spent ten grueling years steadily saving these up.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amazing, ten refracting years. No wonder the librarian turned out so blunt.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa?! A throwing knife!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a message from Jiiya.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's see... 'I have also accumulated three years' worth of stamp cards. If you like, please put them to good use together,' it says.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, there are cards taped right onto the hilt.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Amazing~ Even though the windows and doors are all shut, where did it fly in from~?」

name: Helena
message: 「Thanks, Tamiko-chan!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Again!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's see... 'Think nothing of it, Helena,' it says.」

name: Shio
message: 「T-Tamiko?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's Jiiya's real name. Didn't you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「Whaaat?! You mean to say Sir Jiiya was using a professional alias?!」

name: Misa
message: 「P-Professional alias... He's not a geisha, you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He's quite the accomplished performer, though?」

name: Shio
message: 「Aaaah! I dedicated a prayer plaque wishing to become a master like Sir Jiiya--I must rewrite the name on it at once!」

name: Helena
message: 「Now that we're done with business, this tape will automatically--」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Here it comes, the classic trope!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone, run!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Nanaka-han. Alley-oop... there!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! Don't grab me by the scruff of the neck and use me as a shield!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Geeves always says that the human body serves as an effective cover against hand grenades.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eeeeeek!?」

name: Helena
message: 「--automatically rewind, so please bring it to the chairwoman's office later.」

name: Helena
message: 「Haaah~... Tapes are getting expensive these days, you know. Everything's switched over to CDs and DVDs.」

name: Sally
message: 「Kyu-ping! So this thing's expensive. I'll take it!」

name: Synn
message: 「No you don't. I told you before that stealing is wrong, didn't I?」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmph, I remember! But the Chairwoman'll totally trade me for it!」

name: Ria
message: 「True, knowing Big Sis, she'd probably agree in a heartbeat.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, they are sisters, so there's no tellin'. Still, if it's an item that catches the Chairwoman's eye, it'd have to be somethin' pretty extraordinary, wouldn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see, so Sally-chan doesn't have anything that good, huh.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ufufunofu~, I actually bought something super rare from a Demon World mail-order catalog the other day!」

name: Sally
message: 「Rummage, rummage, rummage... Ta-daaa! The Terrifying, Vicious Hundred-Demon Hell Agony Mega-Boob Potion, 'Oppanium'!」

name: Misa
message: 「A-Amazing. To think Sally-san could actually pronounce kanji with that many strokes!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aah, so that's the part you're surprised about~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's another blatantly shady product name. Don't tell me its effect is literally just--」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, you mustn't listen!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa? Why are you covering my ears?」

name: Sally
message: 「That's right! Even smooth, flat-as-a-board itty-bitty boobies will turn all boing-boing and bouncy-wouncy if you use this potion!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm already plenty well-stocked myself, so... I reckon the Chairwoman wouldn't be needin' any either, don't you think?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You just looked at me for a split second, didn't you!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yours are impressive, Nana-chan~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't call them impressive! You sound like an old man!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Setting myself aside for a moment... let's see, among the Student Council officers, Lolotte-chan is the smallest--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Wawah~!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Sacchin just got sniped!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fueh? It's a phone call from Jeeves」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello, it's me. Yes, yes... I see, understood. Keep up the good work~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There was a venomous scorpion on Sacchin-san's shoulder, so Jeeves accidentally went and took it out with live ammunition, it seems」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So that's what happened, thank you~. I'm completely unhurt, though I kinda thought I was gonna die~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, don't actually believe that?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Actually, a bit late to ask, but where is Riesling-san even sniping from without breaking the window glass?」

name: Synn
message: 「What's been going on this whole time? How did a bullet come flying in without breaking the window?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shut up already, and keep your eyes closed too!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, I can't hear you」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, yes~, I have a brilliant idea. The person with smaller boobs than me is that person right there」

name: Azel
message: 「Will they get bigger!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Sir Azel?」

name: Sally
message: 「They totally will~! Even I got this huge thanks to using the sister product, 'Kyonyuum'!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No, no, no, no, no, no?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's pointless」

name: Synn
message: 「What on earth happened? I've never seen Azel look so dejected」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san is surely troubled about having a small chest」

name: Synn
message: 「So Azel really was worrying about it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go, everyone. We're dragging Azel along with us to hang out」

name: Synn
message: 「And let's go get something sweet somewhere! Whenever you're sad or angry, sweets are the best medicine」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's our Synn, you totally get it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did you remember to bring your loyalty card? Let's make a reservation at Chocolat l'Or right away!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Give it a rest with the showy talk. For a girl whose heart's all aflutter, Koumeika's chestnut yokan is the obvious choice, wouldn't you say?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Western pastries are just greasy junk at the end of the day... No matter how much you eat, it'll all just go straight to your belly, you know?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Traditional Japanese sweets, on the other hand, go straight to your boobs」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Really...!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm lying, though」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, Akane-chan」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr! Don't get all high and mighty just 'cause your boobs are a little big!」

name: Synn
message: 「...How did this conversation turn into a talk about boobs?」

name: Misa
message: 「J-Just forget it! Hurry up, we're going to invite Azel-san!」
Misa grabs my hand.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm」
Pulled along by the hand by Misa, I chase after Azel.
It looks like the final day of exams still has a long way to go.
